# beszel Provider

Interacts with a Beszel hub. Authenticates as a Beszel superuser (PocketBase admin); regular user auth cannot manage systems/users arbitrarily.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email of a Beszel superuser account. May also be set via the BESZEL_EMAIL environment variable. Required one way or the other.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Beszel hub, e.g. https://beszel.example.com. May also be set via the BESZEL_ENDPOINT environment variable. Required one way or the other.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the Beszel superuser account. May also be set via the BESZEL_PASSWORD environment variable. Required one way or the other.
